title: 第13章 超凡之战上第14章 超凡之战下
slug: 全球没功法的我自创功法
content_zh:
林道坐在椅子上，并没有向其他乘客迫不及待下车。
在列车缓缓靠近车站时，他在见闻色霸气感知范围内，就有十二个绿色气息开始向列车靠拢。
林道心神一动，这是冲列车上超凡者来的。
显然列车上这位，绝不是什么善类，只是这群人不怕伤及无辜吗？
与此同时车站外，一位面容精致却透着冷峻，干净利落的短发，身穿黑色制服的女子，深邃的眼睛紧紧注视着列车。
梁红衣在耳麦里冷静道：“所有人注意，以两人为一组，给我盯紧列车门，对方是先天境高手，我们打不过。
若目标出现，就给我跟紧，不要与之硬碰，缠着就行，支援很快就会赶到。”
梁红衣脸色越发冷峻起来，自己只是后天九重境，跟先天境相差太大，只能缠住等待支援。
这一次事情来的太突然，已经没有时间调来太多的黑衣卫。
随着列车上乘客快速下车，林道也缓缓拿起行李箱开始下车，如果再不下车，就显得突兀了。
乘客渐渐地变少，林道清晰感知到列车上，那位超凡者情绪变得焦躁起来。
林道跟其他乘客一起，没表现任何异常，下了列车就开始悠闲往车站外走去。
柳婷与王瑶正在站台处焦急等待，柳婷拿出手机给秦墨雪发送多条信息，都没有回复，拨打电话也没有人接听。
王瑶看着柳婷，担心问道：“婷婷还没有打通吗？”
柳婷皱眉道：“瑶瑶我觉得事情不对，我们去找墨雪。”
秦墨雪刚从列车厕所出来，胸口为之心悸，洁白如玉俏脸一变，美眸一阵紧缩。
这是她与生俱来能力，可以预测祸福，从来没有出过错。
所以秦墨雪看着眼前，满脸阴沉的中年人，身上散发着强烈杀气让她如坠冰窖。
独狼眼神凶恶看着，眼前绝美女孩冷漠道：“小丫头，你运气不太好，下列车时候走在我前面，记住不要乱跑，我随时可以宰了你。”
秦墨雪强迫自己冷静，眼神变得柔弱，害怕道：“好，我什么都答应你，请不要杀我。”

秦墨雪从男人话语得到不少信息，不是绑架犯，是通缉犯，外面被警察包围，她成为人质。
梁红衣的耳麦传来声音：“这里是6队，队长目标人物出现，但是他身前有人质，请指示。”
梁红衣眼神寒光闪烁，沉稳道：“六队听着，跟紧目标，记住不要接近目标五十米，所有后天境全部向六队靠拢，普通人员开始疏散人群。”
吩咐完所有事后，梁红衣向六队所在疾速而去，让六队接近五十米非常危险。
先天境攻击范围可在百米内，但不这么做以先天境的速度，完全可以甩开他们。
秦墨雪下列车时，心中就是一沉，四周太安静，这很不对劲，而且她想趁乱逃跑的计划直接胎死腹中。
感觉紧跟着身后恐怖杀气，让她不寒而栗。
独狼脸色阴沉，眼神凶恶看着，身后紧跟的两条杂鱼，留给他的时间不多了，他已察觉到许多人迅速往这里聚集。
念及到此，独狼身形如离弦之箭一般，仿佛一枚炮弹，朝着身后的两人疾驰而去！
速度快得惊人，令人瞠目结舌。
而那紧跟目标的二人尚未回过神来，甚至连一丝反应，都来不及做出的时候，独狼已然如同鬼魅般，迅速地逼近到他们身前。
此刻的独狼，眼神之中透露出凶残之色，嘴角挂着一抹嗜血狞笑。
与此同时，他的右手肌肉高高隆起，青筋暴起，充满了爆炸性的力量。
其手指闪烁着冰冷的寒光，仿佛能够轻易地撕裂钢铁。
随着独狼的急速冲刺，周围的空气也被搅动起来，发出一阵尖锐的暴鸣声。
紧接着，他的右手以迅雷之势猛地向前贯穿而出，瞬间洞穿了其中一人的胸膛！
content_en:
Lin Dao sat on the chair and did not wait for the other passengers to get off.
As the train slowly approached the station, twelve green auras began to approach the train within his perception range.
Lin Dao's mind suddenly moved, this was for the extraordinary person on the train.
Obviously, the person on the train is definitely not a kind person, but aren't these people afraid of hurting innocent people?
At the same time, outside the station, a woman with a delicate but stern face, neat short hair, and a black uniform stared at the train with her deep eyes.
Liang Hongyi calmly said in the headset: "Everyone, please pay attention, work in groups of two and keep an eye on the train door. The other party is a Xiantian realm master, we can't beat them.
If a target appears, follow me closely. Don't confront it head-on. Just pester it. Support will arrive soon. "
Liang Hongyi's face became more and more serious. She was only in the ninth level of the acquired state, which was very different from the innate state, so she could only wait for support.
This time things happened so suddenly that there was no time to call in too many black-clad guards.
As the passengers on the train quickly got off the train, Lin Dao also slowly picked up his suitcase and started to get off. It would have been abrupt if he didn't get off the train.
The number of passengers gradually dwindled, and Lin Dao clearly sensed that the transcendent person on the train was becoming anxious.
Lin Dao, along with the other passengers, did not show any abnormality. After getting off the train, he began to walk leisurely outside the station.
Liu Ting and Wang Yao were waiting anxiously at the platform. Liu Ting took out her mobile phone and sent multiple messages to Qin Moxue, but there was no reply, and no one answered the call.
Wang Yao looked at Liu Ting and asked worriedly: "Hasn't Tingting gotten through yet?"
Liu Ting frowned and said, "Yao Yao, I think something is wrong. Let's go find Mo Xue."
Qin Moxue had just come out of the train toilet, her chest was palpitating, her pretty face as white as jade changed, and her beautiful eyes tightened.
This is her innate ability to predict misfortune and fortune, and she has never made a mistake.
So Qin Moxue looked at the middle-aged man with a gloomy face in front of her. He exuded a strong murderous aura that made her feel like she had fallen into an ice cellar.
The lone wolf looked at her with ferocious eyes. The beautiful girl in front of him said coldly: "Little girl, you are not very lucky. When you get off the train, walk in front of me. Remember not to run around. I can kill you at any time."
Qin Moxue forced herself to calm down, her eyes became weak, and she said fearfully: "Okay, I promise you everything, please don't kill me."
Qin Moxue got a lot of information from the man's words. He was not a kidnapper, but a wanted criminal. He was surrounded by police outside and she became a hostage.
A voice came from Liang Hongyi's headset: "This is Team 6. The leader's target appears, but there are hostages in front of him. Please give instructions."
Liang Hongyi's eyes flashed coldly and she said calmly: "Team 6, listen, follow the target, and remember not to get closer than fifty meters to the target. All Houtian realms will move closer to Team 6, and ordinary personnel will begin to evacuate the crowd."
After giving all the instructions, Liang Hongyi rushed towards the location of the Sixth Team. It was very dangerous for the Sixth Team to approach fifty meters.
The Xiantian realm's attack range can be within a hundred meters, but otherwise, with the speed of the Xiantian realm, they can be completely thrown away.
When Qin Moxue got off the train, her heart sank. The surroundings were too quiet, something was wrong, and her plan to escape in the chaos was aborted.
She felt the terrifying murderous aura behind her, making her shudder.
The lone wolf's face was gloomy and his eyes were looking fiercely. The two miscellaneous fish were following closely behind him. He didn't have much time left. He had already noticed that many people were quickly gathering here.
Thinking of this, the lone wolf's figure was like an arrow from the string, like a cannonball, speeding towards the two people behind him!
The speed is astonishingly fast and jaw-dropping.
But before the two people who were following the target could recover, and before they even had time to react, the lone wolf was already approaching them like a ghost, quickly approaching them.
At this moment, the lone wolf had a ferocious look in his eyes, and a bloodthirsty smile hanging from the corner of his mouth.At the same time, the muscles of his right hand bulged high and veins popped out, full of explosive power.
Its fingers flashed with an icy cold light, as if they could tear steel easily.
As the lone wolf sprinted rapidly, the surrounding air was stirred up, making a sharp roar.
Immediately afterwards, his right hand shot forward with lightning speed, instantly piercing the chest of one of them!
